about.title: Your marine service provider in North America
text: ABC Marine is your reliable marine service provider for class-related and technical services in North America, and one of the life-saving appliance suppliers in the US Gulf.

Our certificated and experienced professionals offer a package of services for lifeboats and davits, welding, shop machining, and hydraulic and load tests. Our welding professionals are certificated, and we offer ship repairs such as shop machining and hydraulic and proof-load tests.

We are a sales office for the maker Neptune and others in North and South America, and the sales, service and spare parts center for Siyang diesel engines in North and South America. Our shop is in Houston.

facts.heading: Our Offices
items: Houston, Los Angeles and Panama: serviceusa@abc-maritime.com, tel (800) 970-1763 (24/7), fax (713) 799-9480

facts.heading: Recent Projects
items: New Hook Replacement: According to the requirements of Paragraphs 4.4.7.6.4 to 4.4.7.6.6 of MSC.48(66), the International Life-saving Appliance Code, MSC.1392 and MSC.320(89), we performed hook replacements for the vessel Nilza in the shipyard. The maker of the lifeboat is Neptune.

Emergency Service: During annual service performed by a third party, the lifeboat fell to the water from its stowed position. One crew member inside the boat was in critical condition, and the lifeboat was seriously damaged in construction. We performed emergency service and moved the boat to our shop in Houston to strengthen the construction and make related repairs.

Collision Repair: The lifeboat was damaged by hitting a bridge during transportation on a truck, and the whole top part and construction area were damaged. The boat was moved to our shop in Houston for complete repair. A new module was designed and built for the top part to the drawings supplied by the boat maker, Qingdao Beihai.

150T Crane Load Test: Annual survey and proof load test of a 150Te knuckle boom crane to 100% of WLL. During the holding period the crane was slewed left and right five degrees and the test load hoisted up and down 1 meter.
